data.title: AMIS wheat 26 Nov: Punjab median holds at Rs13,063 per 100 kg on 14 mandis
data.summary: The Punjab wheat median was unchanged at Rs5,225 per 40 kg (Rs13,063 per 100 kg) on 26 Nov across 14 mandis, ranging from TT Singh Rs4,100 to Chichawatni and Kamalia Rs5,650 per 40 kg; it is about 9% above late October (Rs11,938 on 29 Oct).

data.title: Sindh raises official regular flour price in Karachi by Rs20 to Rs145/kg
data.summary: A Sindh Food Department notification set regular flour at Rs145/kg (Rs1,450 per 10 kg bag) on 26 Nov; mills receive imported wheat at a subsidised Rs112.50/kg and sell government-wheat flour ex-mill at Rs138/kg, while retail No. 2.5 flour is Rs160–170/kg and fine flour Rs190–200/kg.

data.title: About 273,600 t of Romanian wheat has landed in Pakistan, but inland delays keep flour prices high
data.summary: Five TCP vessels carrying about 273,600 t of Romanian wheat had arrived by 23 Nov (three for Punjab, one each for KP and Sindh), including MV Alex with about 54,980 t at Port Qasim for Punjab; port stocks are building but transport and administrative delays are holding flour prices up.
